reviews.title: Amazing App
reviews.text: I completely love this app. It was a very humbling app in all the right ways. The exercises really teach you that you don’t need an entire gym for an incredible workout and your body is enough! The only reason I gave it four stars is because I really wished that it connected to Apple health. I love seeing all my data in my apple Fitness app and Apple health app and knowing what exercises came where. The exercises really teach you that you don’t need an entire gym for an incredible workout and your body is enough! If you’re someone who has obstacles getting to the gym every day or stay consistent which is ultimately what’s needed to get that dream body, this app really does solve all those problems! Give it a try! Your body will thank you!

reviews.title: Great app with good workouts
reviews.text: I have been using this app and the hería pro app to do hiit workouts for a while now and the only thing I would change about this app is the ability to modify existing workouts with exercises that fit your current equipment better or personal preference.  Personally I love the workouts and I am getting stronger but I do sometimes wish I could customize the workouts and change certain exercises within workouts to fit my preference a little more.  I think the coolest addition would be if there were an option to use a template of Chris’s workout and then have options of similar exercises to substitute out for a certain movement that you might not have the equipment for, or the strength/coordination to do it properly yet.  Overall a great app though. I have been following Chris hería for years on YouTube and love the calisthenics philosophy.

reviews.title: One of the best out there
reviews.text:
I'm super impressed. The Thenx crew managed to make a platform that is accessible, super inspiring, and even products I want to buy and support them!

Their app is amazing. Daily workouts and basic programs are not gated by pay walls, making me appreciate their brand and commitment to fitness even more. What you can do for the price is amazing, and their subscription only makes it better. 
The workouts are effective and shows the muscle groups on the app along with a exercise tutorial. 
The community aspect motivates as you see how widespread the drive is to get, stay or grow in fitness. 
Plus: calesthenics. Need I say more?

reviews.title: App
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for my workouts and even subscribed to the premium plan, but recently I’ve been facing serious issues. Today at the gym, the app showed a “request failed” message and none of my workouts appeared. This is really frustrating, especially when I rely on the app during my sessions.

It feels like the app isn’t being properly maintained or updated. As a paying user, I expect a stable experience and timely fixes. I hope the team looks into this issue soon and improves the app’s reliability. The workouts are good, but the app performance needs immediate attention.

reviews.title: Love it but a little glitchy
reviews.text: Updated: App has a few glitches where videos won’t load or timers are off. The main issue is that timers are tied to videos loading so even if you know the exercise, the timer won’t start if the video doesn’t. The timer between rounds of the warm up are also off. They default to 2 mins instead of the number os seconds they should be. The workouts themselves are great though.

reviews.title: Best Calisthenics app I’ve had
reviews.text: Love this app, it has all the bases you need and more to build your calisthenics skills and general health and fitness.  The workouts and programs they have are perfect for steady progress through your fitness and calisthenics journey.  Some of the extras and side tools they have I don’t use, but only because they’re not for me, not because they’re useless (cause they’re not).  Overall great app, it has led me through my fitness journey the past 2 years (I’m 16) and I’ve seen fast and crazy results.  The key is to keep going, keep that steady progress, and stay motivated.  You’ll see change in no time.  Stay strong 💪🔥

reviews.title: This app used to be amazing
reviews.text:
This app used to be amazing prior to the recent overhaul/update. Now none of the workouts have names so you have to go into each one to figure out what muscles you’d target. It’s also impossible to find anything now as workouts, programs etc. are scattered everywhere, and the home screen is so hard to know what you’re looking at because each section looks the same. 
Fix the user experience and add tags/titles to each workout again and the app rating will continue to do well. Or just go back to the old version if it’s easier. You still rock, Chris!
